cards.text:
card 81000000 "不屈的战士" (Follower, clan=Swordcraft, cost=2, atk=2, life=2):

    fanfare:

    evolve:

cards.text:
card 81000022 "突击神器" (Follower, clan=Portalcraft, cost=3, atk=2, life=2):
    traits: [Artifact]
    keywords: [rush]
    fuse: any:board All where has trait Artifact
    on_fuse zone=Hand on($self):
        if (ctr:fuse_cost >= 1 and ctr:fuse_cost <= 1):
            transform $self into #90073110
        elif (ctr:fuse_cost >= 2 and ctr:fuse_cost <= 2):
            transform $self into #90073120
        elif ctr:fuse_cost >= 3:
            transform $self into #90073130
cards.name: 突击神器
